_comment: Beta SoC production config — matches real hardware memory map

acpu._isa_comment: ISA string selects CPU type (rv64->rva23s64 profile). Full 64-extension list aligned with Beta ISA Status.xlsx is in beta_dtb.c isa_exts[]

aplic._comment: APLIC supports 144 interrupt sources per interrupt vector table rev2

imsic._comment: IMSIC per-cluster: cluster_base=0x0710000000+cluster*0x1000000, M@+0x200000, S@+0x400000, GEILEN=1. Hardware: 2048 IDs; QEMU/AIA spec cap=2047 (11-bit field)

plic._comment: No legacy PLIC, using AIA (APLIC+IMSIC) only

registers.name: MSTR
registers._comment: DWC UMCTL2 Master Register: ddr_type, burst_rdwr, data_bus_width; firmware programs on init

registers.name: STAT
registers._comment: bits[1:0]=operating_mode: 0=init,1=normal,2=power-down,3=self-refresh; reset=1=Normal (init done)

registers.name: MRSTAT
registers._comment: bit[0]=mr_wr_busy; reset=0 (not busy); firmware polls this after MR writes

registers.name: PWRCTL
registers._comment: bit[0]=selfref_en; bit[1]=powerdown_en; bit[3]=en_dfi_dram_clk_disable; default=0 (all disabled)

registers.name: RFSHCTL3
registers._comment: bit[0]=dis_auto_refresh; bit[1]=refresh_update_level; stub: accepted

registers.name: CRCPARSTAT
registers._comment: DFI parity/CRC error status; reset=0 (no errors)

registers.name: DFIMISC
registers._comment: bit[0]=dfi_init_complete_en; reset=1 (tracking enabled; DFISTAT.dfi_init_complete is valid)

registers.name: DFISTAT
registers._comment: bit[0]=dfi_init_complete (PHY training done); bit[1]=dfi_lp_ack; reset=1 → firmware PHY-ready poll exits immediately

registers.name: SWCTL
registers._comment: bit[0]=sw_done; firmware writes 0 before quasi-dynamic reg writes, then 1 to commit; callback mirrors to SWSTAT

registers.name: SWSTAT
registers._comment: bit[0]=sw_done_ack; mirrors SWCTL[0] via callback; reset=1 (no pending config change)

registers.name: PSTAT
registers._comment: bits[7:0]=rd_port_busy_0..7; bits[23:16]=wr_port_busy_0..7; reset=0 (no outstanding AXI transactions)

registers.name: CHAN_SIZE_MB
registers._comment: Vendor-defined capacity register: channel size in MB; 0x1000=4096MB=4GB per channel; BLOCKED: offset TBD from DDR IP docs
